h1: ☿ Mercury in Astrology: Mind • Message • Mapping
subtitle: Domicile: Gemini , Virgo • Exaltation: Virgo
summary: Mercury governs communication, thinking, learning, commerce, and local travel, defining how you collect, process, and relay information. Ruling Gemini and Virgo, it influences your speaking style, problem-solving, daily systems, and adaptability. Its sign, house, and aspects flag decision speed, negotiation tactics, tech and data fluency, and the tone of your inner voice. During Mercury retrograde, prioritize review and repairs in messages, contracts, schedules, and devices.

sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Mercury is your interface with the world: how you name things, connect dots, and explain ideas. When Mercury flows, work feels simple and conversations land. When it’s jammed, wires cross and details leak.

✅ What it wants

  • Clear inputs and low-latency feedback
  • Freedom to tweak, test, and iterate
  • Honest conversations over vague signals

⚠️ When it struggles

  • Overthinking, info-hoarding, hot takes
  • Chaos calendars; lost logistics
  • Talking instead of deciding

🧭 Feed it well

  • Daily capture → weekly sort → monthly ship
  • Write before you meet; decide in writing
  • Protect deep work windows

Logistics & Tools

Read These First

sections.heading: Retrogrades & Cycles (review, don’t panic)
sections.html:
Retrograde rhythm

  • Happens 3–4×/yr, ~3 weeks
  • Best for edits, reviews, reconnecting
  • Back up devices; confirm times/places

House focus

  • Track which house Mercury is retrograding in
  • Revisit plans there; don’t force launches
  • Watch aspects (e.g., Mercury square Neptune)

Synastry & work

  • Your Mercury ↔ their Mercury = comms chemistry
  • Your Mercury ↔ their Saturn = edits, standards, delays
  • Use full compatibility for nuance

sections.heading: Quick Practice (upgrade your comms)
sections.html:
Journal

  • Where do my ideas stall?
  • What decision needs a one-page write-up?
  • Which habit would halve my context switching?

Body & workflow

  • Daily capture → inbox zero → two blocks of deep work
  • Meetings only with agendas and decisions
  • Turn chats into tickets or docs

Read your map

  • Check Mercury’s sign + house
  • Note 3 major aspects
  • Plan for the next retrograde window
